versions.content: Symbolic name: SCHM_E_LOST_DATA Value: 64 Comments: An API call for reading received data with event semantics indicates that some incoming data has been lost due to an overflow of the receive queue or due to an error of the underlying communication stack. Note: The value has to be identical with [SWS_Rte_02571]
